oracle_facts.nalfeshnee_text: Flying. Whenever you cast a spell from exile, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. If it's a permanent spell, the copy gains haste and 'At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this permanent.'
oracle_facts.physical_copy_policy: Copies are objects on stack, NOT cast. A copy of permanent spell becomes token on resolving but is NOT a 'create a token' event, and token is sacrificed only at beginning of end step. A sorcery copy resolves before original, can choose targets independently. Nonhand actual cast gets Lost and Keeper; virtual copy gets neither, no storm or Abaddon cascade.
oracle_facts.boltwave_text: {R} sorcery, deals 3 damage to each opponent.

fixture.source: Preferred complete staged 100 card challenger, 99 actual noncommander cards physically conserved in deck/hand/field/stack/exile/graveyard; virtual copy-token ledger separate
fixture.source_paid: Call Forth the Tempest from hand after eight distinct physical untapped basic lands pay 5RRR; if opponents have previously lost 9 life from loyal, 3 independently stacked outer cascades; otherwise 2 printed cascades.
fixture.cascade_order: Top of real deck rearranged to specific actual card names. Spell-copy trigger resolves before the original (ordering of trigger above spell) and subsequent outer cascades continue. No random draw or win probability is implied.
fixture.permanent_copy: Original artifact and copied permanent token both enter the battlefield, but only original is a physical source-card. The copied token has haste, and scheduled end-step sacrifice applies only to the copy.
fixture.opponent_loss: Boltwave copy and original each affect 3 real opponents for 3 life, explicitly conditional on no damage prevention; initial X checked at original hand cast, not retroactive.

registered_cases.expected: First exile-cast Arcane Signet MV2 produces a Nalfeshnee spell copy -> haste token on resolution and normal source artifact; end-step sacrifice removes only copy. One cast produces one Lost Spawn and one Keeper trigger at MV2, no extra Abaddon cascade.

One physically cast Boltwave MV1 from Call printed cascade produces exactly one virtual copy and one original resolution: 6 damage to EACH opponent in absence of prevention, but only one nonhand cast, Lost spawn, and Keeper target damage 1.
Hand Call MV8 X9 provides 3 independently sourced cascade casts Arcane Signet MV2, Sol Ring MV1, Boltwave MV1. Each produces Nalf copy, but Call sweeper other cast MV=4 (not 8) and Lost Spawn=3.
Hand Call X0 has only two printed cascades; first Boltwave copy + original creates opponent aggregate 18 loss after Call cast; never grants retroactive third cascade.
After physical exile Boltwave cast, opponent counters its original while Nalf spell-copy trigger/copy still resolves. Three damage each from copy, one actual cast, original ends in graveyard.
Nalfeshnee removed after first exile spell cast and its triggered copy ability placed on stack; first copy persists, later exiled physical casts do NOT copy.
Drannith and Rule of Law in separate policies both deny cascade exile casts after hand Call; printed/Abaddon cascade abilities still resolve but generate no Nalf copies or Lost spawns.
Nalfeshnee itself is first spell cast from exile and enters from first cascade, cannot copy its own cast; the later two exile-cast artifacts are copied once each.

With Wild-Magic on battlefield, first Arcane Signet cast from exile gains one extra cascade hitting physically sourced Sol Ring; both real casts get Nalf copies (not four casts), their spell copies cannot themselves gain or trigger cascade. Other printed Call hit proceeds independently.

stop_rule: 9 deterministic methods; no randomized games, no new deck changes or M6 certifications; preserve three original gap topics until exact-head CI passes P0-025.
